risk_if_not_implemented: Without Identity Evidence Validation & Verification, required evidence, logs and chain-of-custody integrity may be unavailable or unreliable when needed for investigation or legal proceedings. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14).

compensating_control_1.name: Identification & Authentication for Organizational Users
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to uniquely identify and centrally Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) organizational users and processes acting on behalf of organizational users.
compensating_control_1.justification: Identification & Authentication for Organizational Users (IAC-32) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Identity Evidence Validation & Verification (IAC-05.3) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Identity Proofing (Identity Verification)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to verify the identity of a user before issuing authenticators or modifying access permissions.
compensating_control_2.justification: Identity Proofing (Identity Verification) (IAC-05) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Identity Evidence Validation & Verification (IAC-05.3) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
